Aspera Connect — if something goes wrong
=========================================

PC INSTALL
----------
Problem: .deb won't install / "dependency error"
Fix:     sudo apt update
         sudo apt install ./AsperaConnect-Desktop.deb

Problem: App not in menu after install
Fix:     Log out and log back in, or run: aspera-connect

PHONE INSTALL
-------------
Problem: Installing the APK is too hard / Play Protect / USB hell
Fix:     Use Google Play Internal testing (live):
           https://play.google.com/apps/internaltest/4701460117553190758
         Or PC → Get phone app (Play) → scan QR.
         Phone Google account must be on the tester list.
         No USB. No Developer Options.

Problem: Play says app not available
Fix:     Sign in with an allow-listed Gmail, or ask IT to add your email
         to Internal testers.

Problem: Google Play Protect — "App blocked to protect your device" (only OK button)
Fix:     HARD BLOCK — USB is a temporary IT workaround only (INSTALL-PHONE-USB.txt).
         Real fix: Play Store Internal testing for company phones.

Problem: "Install blocked" / can't install APK (unknown sources)
Fix:     Settings → Apps → Special access → Install unknown apps → allow Chrome
         (Not Developer Options.) Download again → Install

Problem: App installs but calls don't work
Fix:     Open app → allow Phone, Answer calls, Contacts, Notifications
         Tap "Start for calls" — keep the notification

Problem: Phone stops working after a while (OnePlus / Xiaomi / Samsung)
Fix:     Settings → Battery → Aspera Connect → Unrestricted / Don't optimize

CONNECT (PC ↔ PHONE)
--------------------
Problem: Different Wi‑Fi / PC on LAN, phone elsewhere
Fix:     Use internet QR (WhatsApp-style):
           PC → Show QR to pair
           Phone → Scan PC QR
         Company relay is LIVE: wss://aspera-connect-relay.onrender.com
         New builds use this by default. Older installs: set relayUrl in
         ~/.config/aspera-connect/config.json to that wss:// URL.

Problem: How to pair without typing IP
Fix:     PC: Phone calls → Show QR to pair
         Phone: Scan PC QR
         First try after idle may take ~1 min (free Render cold start).

Problem: Phone has no camera / camera blocked / USB camera not available
Fix:     PC: Show QR → Copy pair code (or expand Show text code)
         Send the text to the phone (WhatsApp / email / USB file)
         Phone app: Paste pair code → Pair
         Same result as scanning — no camera needed.

Problem: QR pair hangs / "cloud pair failed" after long idle
Fix:     Wait up to 60s for relay wake, try Show QR again.
         Or keep relay warm: open https://aspera-connect-relay.onrender.com/health

Problem: "Not connected" / "unreachable" / "no route" (LAN mode)
Fix:     1. Phone: Start for calls (notification visible)
         2. PC and phone on SAME network (PC LAN + phone on that router's Wi‑Fi)
         3. Same Wi‑Fi band if router splits 2.4 / 5 GHz
         4. Show QR (internet) or copy IP from phone → Connect
         5. Or click "Find phone on network"

Problem: Worked on 5 GHz, fails on 2.4 GHz (or opposite)
Fix:     IP changes when you switch band — update IP or use Find phone

Problem: "Find phone on network" finds nothing
Fix:     Phone must show "Start for calls" / Waiting
         Same office network (not guest Wi-Fi)
         Try entering IP manually from phone screen

Problem: Connected before, stopped working
Fix:     Phone may have closed the service — open app → Start for calls again
         Check phone battery optimization (see above)

USING THE APP
-------------
Problem: "Call from clipboard" fails
Fix:     Linux Mint:  sudo apt install xclip
         KDE/Wayland: sudo apt install wl-clipboard
         Copy a phone number first, then tray → Call from clipboard

Problem: Zoho / browser phone link doesn't dial
Fix:     1. PC app open and Connected (sidebar shows Linked)
         2. Click "Make Aspera handle tel: links" once
         3. Try the link again

Problem: Contacts empty / sync failed
Fix:     Allow Contacts on phone → Connect again → Sync from phone

Problem: Hang up doesn't work
Fix:     On phone allow "Answer/end calls" permission → try again

Still stuck?
------------
Note: phone model, PC version (Linux Mint?), error text on red banner
Send to IT / Shree with a screenshot.
